build.beforeDevCommand: npm run extraction:prepare -- --tauri && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run extraction:prepare -- --tauri && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'
